name: LeaguePilot
ux_implications: Coach and admin complexity should not leak into parent flows.
Role-specific disclosure should make what/when/where/action/change instantly clear.
dominant_questions: What action does this role need to take now?
design_emphasis: Optimize for one-handed mobile comprehension and short decision loops.
Keep role-specific complexity hidden until it is relevant.

actor_defaults.actor: Parent, coach, or admin checking the next coordination step
actor_defaults.object: Schedule, event, roster, or team update
actor_defaults.goal: Understand what changed and what action is needed now
actor_defaults.decision: Whether this role must attend, respond, or update others
actor_defaults.state: Community state changes frequently and should be easy to scan
actor_defaults.blocker: Important schedule or action details are buried behind admin complexity
actor_defaults.authority: Current schedule truth, role permissions, and repository evidence
actor_defaults.next_action: Show the next role-specific action with time and location context
